data.name: Enthrall
data.description: Once per day, you can make one creature your thrall (Will %1 negates).  The affected creature will follow any instruction you give, including harming itself, although obviously self-destructive orders give the target an additional save each round it is under those orders.  You may only have one thrall at any given time and the thrall gains a new save to negate the effect every 24 hours from the time it became your thrall.  This is considered a mind-affecting, compulsion effect.|MindbenderEnthrallDC
